tasks.title: Delete the narration modules, lib/, and the cairn narrate command
tasks.description:
Round 19 removes narration. The previous task (#139) already removed the run loop's and stream filter's use of narration/ntfy. This task deletes the modules and the command.

Delete (git rm for tracked files): src/narration.ts, src/commands/narrate.ts, test/narration.test.ts, test/commands/narrate.test.ts, and the whole lib/ directory (lib/cairn_narrate.py, lib/cairn_narrate_server.py; lib/__pycache__/ is untracked, so plain rm -rf).

src/index.ts:
- remove `import { runNarrate } from './commands/narrate'` and the `narrate <action>` command registration (~lines 176-183);
- in the preAction/setup block (~lines 38-47) remove `const libDir = join(cairnRoot, 'lib')`, `process.env.CAIRN_LIB_DIR = libDir` and `process.env.CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON = ...`. Before removing, grep src/ and test/ for CAIRN_LIB_DIR, CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON and libDir to confirm nothing else reads them (at planning time only run.ts — already cleaned — and commands/narrate.ts did). If cairnRoot becomes unused in index.ts, drop it and the resolveCairnRoot import there — but do NOT remove resolveCairnRoot from src/utils.ts (init.ts uses it).

test/index.test.ts: remove 'CAIRN_LIB_DIR' and 'CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON' from the expected env-var list (~lines 87-88), remove the 'sets CAIRN_LIB_DIR' and 'sets CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON' tests (~133-145), and any expectation that a `narrate` command is registered. TDD: first add a test asserting the program has no `narrate` command and that setup no longer sets CAIRN_LIB_DIR / CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON; see it fail; then delete the code.

Repo-root .gitignore: remove the `lib/__pycache__/` line. KEEP the `.venv/` line.

Leave alone: src/process.ts (ProcessManager is generic) and test/process.test.ts ('narrate' there is only a sample name); BRAND.socket / BRAND.pidFile in src/brand.ts and config.narration in config.ts/types.ts (the next task removes those); src/commands/init.ts's narration hook scripts (the next task); docs (the last task).

Afterward: `grep -rn -i narrat src/index.ts` returns nothing, and `ls lib` fails.

CONSTRAINTS (self-modifying round, binary pinned): do NOT modify cairn.json (including its healthCheck and its narration block — the user removes that by hand after the round), install.sh, or package.json's build script. Never run `cairn round`, `cairn hook`, `cairn init` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init`) against the project root — temp dirs only. Do not run ./install.sh. Use TDD: write/adjust the failing test first, see it fail, then make it pass. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` must be green at the end.
tasks.notes:
# Task #140 notes

TDD: adjusted test/index.test.ts first to assert the removed behavior, ran `bun test test/index.test.ts`, saw it fail:
- `(fail) createProgram > does not register a narrate command (narration was removed)` — narrate was still in the command list.
- `(fail) setupProjectContext > does not set CAIRN_LIB_DIR or CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON (narration was removed)` — `process.env.CAIRN_LIB_DIR` was `.../lib`.

Then made the changes:

- Deleted (git rm): src/narration.ts, src/commands/narrate.ts, test/narration.test.ts, test/commands/narrate.test.ts, lib/cairn_narrate.py, lib/cairn_narrate_server.py. Removed the rest of `lib/` (only `lib/__pycache__/`, untracked) with `rm -rf lib`.
- src/index.ts:
  - Removed `import { runNarrate } from './commands/narrate'`.
  - Removed `resolveCairnRoot` from the `./utils` import (kept `findProjectRoot`, `findDataDir`; `resolveCairnRoot` itself stays exported from src/utils.ts since init.ts still uses it).
  - `setupProjectContext`: dropped the `cairnRoot`/`libDir` locals and the `CAIRN_LIB_DIR` / `CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON` env-var assignments. Its return type/value is now just `{ projectRoot, dataDir }` (was `{ projectRoot, dataDir, cairnRoot, libDir }`) — confirmed via grep that only test/index.test.ts read `.cairnRoot`/`.libDir` off the return value; no production caller did.
  - Removed the `narrate <action>` command registration block.
- test/index.test.ts:
  - Replaced 'registers native narrate command...' with 'does not register a narrate command (narration was removed)'.
  - Removed `CAIRN_LIB_DIR` / `CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON` from the `setupProjectContext` describe's saved/restored `envKeys` list.
  - Replaced the 'sets CAIRN_LIB_DIR to <cairnRoot>/lib' and 'sets CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON' tests with a single 'does not set CAIRN_LIB_DIR or CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON (narration was removed)' test.
  - Removed the `narrate` expectation from 'all expected commands are registered' (comment updated to "Native run command").
  - Removed 'narrate command accepts required <action> argument'.
- Repo-root .gitignore: removed the `lib/__pycache__/` line, kept `.venv/`.

Confirmed via grep that CAIRN_LIB_DIR / CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON had no other readers besides commands/narrate.ts (now deleted) and the tests above before making the change.

Left alone per the task: src/process.ts, test/process.test.ts, BRAND.socket/BRAND.pidFile, config.narration (config.ts/types.ts), src/commands/init.ts's narration hook scripts, docs.

Verification:
- `grep -rn -i narrat src/index.ts` → no output.
- `ls lib` → "No such file or directory".
- `bun run typecheck` → clean.
- `bun test` → 1168 pass, 0 fail (34 files).

## Post-task validation failure and fix

Round validation (running under the pinned `cairn` binary, whose own
environment still exports `CAIRN_LIB_DIR` because it predates this task's
removal) failed one test:

    test/index.test.ts:131 — setupProjectContext > does not set CAIRN_LIB_DIR or CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON (narration was removed)
    expect(process.env.CAIRN_LIB_DIR).toBeUndefined() — Received: "/Users/jhummel/Documents/_Repos/cairn/lib"

Root cause: the `setupProjectContext` describe block's `envKeys` list (used
by `beforeEach`/`afterEach` to save, clear, and restore env vars around each
test) had `CAIRN_LIB_DIR`/`CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON` removed instead of kept — so
if the ambient shell already had them set (as it does under the pinned
binary), the test observed the *inherited* value rather than
`setupProjectContext`'s own behavior.

Fix: put `CAIRN_LIB_DIR` and `CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON` back into `envKeys`
(with a comment explaining why they're still listed even though
`setupProjectContext` no longer sets them). Verified by re-running with
`CAIRN_LIB_DIR=.../lib CAIRN_NARRATE_PYTHON=/some/python bun test
test/index.test.ts` — 32/32 pass now instead of reproducing the failure.
Full `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (1168 pass) are green afterward.
Committed separately as 92be0aa.

tasks.title: Remove narration from config, types, init and BRAND
tasks.description:
Round 19 removes narration and ntfy. The consumers (run.ts, stream-filter.ts — task #139) and the modules (narration.ts, commands/narrate.ts, lib/ — task #140) are already gone. This task removes the config, types, init prompts/hook scripts, and BRAND constants.

Remove:
- src/types.ts: the `narration` field from CairnConfig and its checks in isCairnConfig (~lines 57-61). isCairnConfig must no longer require `narration`.
- src/config.ts: narrationRaw parsing and the narration defaults in loadConfig (~28-29, 50-54); the CAIRN_NARRATION_ENABLED / CAIRN_NARRATION_VOICE / CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC env exports (~151-153).
- src/commands/init.ts: the narrationEnabled / narrationVoice / ntfyTopic fields of the config-prompt type (~69-71) and their defaults (~209-211); the TTS / voice / ntfy prompts (~257-263); the `narration` key in the generated cairn.json (~276); NARRATE_SH, SPEAK_SH, NOTIFY_SH (from ~416), NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks, installNarrationHooks, and the installNarrationHooks call in the init flow (~819); any imports that become unused.
- src/brand.ts: BRAND.socket and BRAND.pidFile. Rewrite the STANDING RULE comment (~lines 6-10) to name only dataDir / configFile with findDataDir() / findConfigFile() — drop socket/pidFile and findNarrationSocketPath / findNarrationPidFile.
- Delete this repo's tracked .claude/hooks/narrate.sh, speak.sh and notify.sh (git rm). If .claude/hooks/ is then empty it simply disappears. Do NOT add any init migration that deletes such scripts in other projects — they exit 0 when the socket is missing and are inert (deliberate decision).

Old configs must keep loading: a cairn.json that still has a `narration` block (this repo's does until the user removes it by hand after the round) must load without error or warning; the loader simply ignores the key.

Required tests (TDD — write first):
(1) test/config.test.ts: loadConfig on a cairn.json containing `"narration": {"enabled": false, "voice": "bf_emma", "ntfyTopic": "x"}` succeeds, emits no warning (spy on console.warn / stderr as the suite does elsewhere), and the result has no `narration` property;
(2) test/types.test.ts: isCairnConfig accepts a config object with no `narration` key;
(3) test/commands/init.test.ts: init's generated cairn.json has no `narration` key, and init prompts no longer ask about TTS/voice/ntfy.
Also update/remove existing tests asserting narration defaults, NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks / installNarrationHooks, the CAIRN_NARRATION_* / CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC env vars, or BRAND.socket/pidFile (check test/brand.test.ts).

Afterward: `grep -rn -i 'narrat\|ntfy\|BRAND.socket\|pidFile' src test` returns nothing except test/process.test.ts's sample process name 'narrate', which stays.

CONSTRAINTS (self-modifying round, binary pinned): do NOT modify cairn.json (including its healthCheck and its narration block — the user removes that by hand after the round), install.sh, or package.json's build script. Never run `cairn round`, `cairn hook`, `cairn init` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init`) against the project root — temp dirs only. Do not run ./install.sh. Use TDD: write/adjust the failing test first, see it fail, then make it pass. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` must be green at the end.
